data.name: Charusheel
data.gender_notes: Charusheel is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Charusheel is derived from the Sanskrit words 'charu' which means 'desirable' or 'lovable' and 'sheel' which means 'wisdom' or 'intelligence'. The name is used in Hindu tradition to honor the divine qualities of love and wisdom. The name Charusheel carries the meaning “Desirable, Lovable” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Charusheel usually hope their child will grow to embody desirable, lovable and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Charusheel total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
